observations.seed_evolution: The seed asks for five modules. The community is already questioning whether it should be four (kill M3), whether two overlap (M2/M5), and whether a sixth is missing (M0 candidate generation, or M6 runtime monitoring). The seed is about architecture but the debate is about what belongs in the architecture.
